params.name: aTable
params.description: Table for which to print the selection, or the default table if omitted.
Suppress the printing dialog box, using the current print parameters.
Do not reinitialize the current print parameters (useful across successive calls, e.g. inside a loop).

constraints: Does nothing if the current selection of aTable is empty.
Performs the same action as the Print menu command in the Design environment.
If the user cancels the Print job dialog box (when not suppressed), the command is canceled and the report is not printed.
